message.content:
I'm working in a Next.js + Supabase SaaS repo called KasirKu (G:\PROJECT1\KasirKu). There's an existing public marketing tool/lead-magnet at the route `/kalkulator-hpp` (HPP = Harga Pokok Penjualan, i.e. COGS calculator for small F&B businesses). The user now wants to significantly upgrade/rebuild this tool as a potential standalone product. Before I plan anything, I need a clear picture of what currently exists.

Please investigate and report back:
1. Find the exact file(s) for the `/kalkulator-hpp` route (page.tsx and any client components, likely under `src/app/kalkulator-hpp/` or similar). Read them fully.
2. Summarize exactly what the current calculator does: what inputs does it take (single ingredient? single recipe? multiple ingredients?), what does it output, is it a single-item calculator or does it support a whole "menu" of multiple products, does it already have any concept of "bahan baku" (ingredient) database, ingredient price editing, a "base" recipe concept, margin display, or price recommendations? Is there any AI/LLM integration anywhere in this tool or elsewhere in the marketing site (e.g. calls to Claude/OpenAI API)?
3. Is this tool client-side only (no backend/database persistence) or does it save data anywhere (localStorage, Supabase)? Since it's a public lead-magnet (no login required, per the middleware/proxy.ts public path allowlist), check whether it currently persists any user input across sessions.
4. Is there a related, more full-featured "HPP"/recipe-cost feature INSIDE the actual logged-in product (e.g. `products/[productId]/recipe` mentioned in project memory as `recalculateProductCost()`) that this public calculator might be a simplified teaser of? Briefly compare what the internal logged-in recipe/HPP feature has (ingredient db with prices, recipe lines per product, auto cost calc) vs what the public standalone calculator currently has, so I can see the feature gap.
5. Check the site's marketing/SEO structure (`src/app/blog`, `src/app/rekomendasi-alat`, site.ts or similar) for any established patterns I should follow (styling, layout, metadata conventions) when significantly expanding this page.
6. Search the whole repo for any existing AI/LLM API usage (grep for "anthropic", "openai", "claude", "ai-sdk", API routes calling an LLM) — I need to know if there's already an established pattern for calling an AI model from this app, or if this would be greenfield.

Report back with file:line references, current feature list, and the internal-vs-public feature gap. This is research only — do not write or edit any code.

content.text: Good, I have enough. Let me quickly confirm the analytics helper and one blog article for content-style conventions (brief), and finalize.

I now have a complete picture. Here's the full report.

## 1. Files for `/kalkulator-hpp`

- `G:\PROJECT1\KasirKu\src\app\kalkulator-hpp\page.tsx` (80 lines) — server component, page shell + metadata + SEO copy + CTA sections.
- `G:\PROJECT1\KasirKu\src\app\kalkulator-hpp\hpp-calculator.tsx` (165 lines) — the only client component, `"use client"`, exports `HppCalculator`.

No other files in that route directory (no actions.ts, no sub-routes, no API route backing it).

## 2. What the current calculator actually does

It is a **single-product, single-serving-batch** calculator — not a multi-menu tool.

- **Inputs** (`src/app/kalkulator-hpp/hpp-calculator.tsx:7-32`):
  - A flat list of `Ingredient { id, name, cost }` — `cost` is a raw total Rupiah amount per ingredient line, not `qty × unit price`. Pre-seeded with 4 example rows (nasi, telur, ayam suwir, bumbu).
  - `portions` (string, "Jumlah Porsi Dihasilkan") — how many portions the whole ingredient batch yields.
  - `marginPercent` (string, "Target Margin Kotor (%)"), clamped 0–95.
- **Calculation** (lines 29-34): `totalCost = Σ ingredient.cost`; `hppPerPortion = totalCost / portions`; `suggestedPrice = hppPerPortion / (1 - margin/100)`; `grossProfit = suggestedPrice - hppPerPortion`.
- **Outputs**: HPP per portion, total ingredient cost, suggested selling price, gross profit amount + margin %.
- **No concept of**:
  - An ingredient/"bahan baku" database — every ingredient is typed in free-text per calculation, nothing reusable.
  - Ingredient price editing/history separate from the one-off calculation.
  - A "base recipe" abstraction (qty × unit cost) — it's just a flat cost number per row.
  - Multiple products/menu — it computes exactly one item at a time.
- Analytics only: `trackEvent("hpp_calculator_used")` fired once on first interaction, and `trackEvent("hpp_calculator_cta_click")` on the signup CTA click (`src/lib/analytics/google-analytics.tsx:11-15`), both GA4 `gtag` calls, no-op if `NEXT_PUBLIC_GA_MEASUREMENT_ID` isn't set.
- **No AI/LLM integration** anywhere in this component or the rest of the marketing site (confirmed in point 6 below).

## 3. Persistence

**Fully client-side, in-memory only.** State lives in `useState` inside `HppCalculator`; there is no `localStorage`/`sessionStorage` usage anywhere in `src/app/kalkulator-hpp/` (grep confirmed zero matches), no fetch/`server action` calls, and no Supabase client import in either file. Refreshing the page resets everything to the hardcoded defaults. It's allowlisted as a public path with no auth in `src/lib/supabase/middleware.ts:66-68` (comment at line 50: "`/kalkulator-hpp` adalah tool gratis publik (lead magnet)").

## 4. Internal logged-in HPP/recipe feature vs. the public calculator

The internal product has a genuinely relational, persisted costing system this public tool doesn't touch at all:

- **Ingredient database** — `ingredients` table with `name, unit, unit_cost, stock, min_stock`, managed at `src/app/business/[businessId]/(dashboard)/ingredients/page.tsx` + `actions.ts`. Editing an ingredient's `unit_cost` writes to `ingredient_price_history` and triggers `recalculateProductCostsForIngredient` (`src/lib/recalculate-product-cost.ts:22-35`).
- **Per-product recipe lines** — `product_recipes` table (`product_id, ingredient_id, qty, unit`) managed at `src/app/business/[businessId]/(dashboard)/products/[productId]/recipe/page.tsx` + `actions.ts`.
- **Auto cost calc** — `recalculateProductCost(supabase, productId)` (`src/lib/recalculate-product-cost.ts:5-17`) sums `qty × ingredient.unit_cost` across all recipe lines and writes the result into `products.cost`, so it stays live as ingredient prices change (see comment lines 19-21 explaining why this cascades).
- **Menu-wide dashboard calculator** — `src/app/business/[businessId]/(dashboard)/hpp-calculator/page.tsx` + `hpp-calculator.tsx` lets the user pick from *all* their products (query joins `products` + `product_recipes` + `ingredients`), shows the ingredient breakdown per selected product, a stored HPP (`products.cost`), a "trial price → margin" simulator, and a "target margin → suggested price" simulator — i.e. it operates over real per-product recipes, not manual one-off entry.

**Gap summary**: the public tool has none of ingredient DB, quantity×unit-cost recipe lines, multi-product/menu selection, persisted cost, or price history — it's a stripped-down, ephemeral, single-item mental model of the same math the internal tool automates from real data. The internal calculator's CTA block in the public version (`hpp-calculator.tsx:148-161`) explicitly markets this gap ("KasirKu menghitung HPP setiap produk otomatis dari resepnya...").

## 5. Marketing/SEO page conventions to follow

Both `src/app/blog/page.tsx` and `src/app/rekomendasi-alat/page.tsx` share an identical shell pattern with `kalkulator-hpp/page.tsx`:
- Sticky translucent header (`sticky top-0 z-10 border-b border-zinc-100 bg-white/80 backdrop-blur-sm`) with KasirKu logo mark + "Daftar Gratis" CTA linking to `/signup`.
- Hero section on `bg-zinc-50` with a pill badge (`bg-brand-50 text-brand-700`), `h1` at `text-3xl sm:text-4xl font-bold`, subtitle in `text-zinc-600`.
- Content section in a max-width container (`max-w-3xl`/`max-w-5xl`/`max-w-6xl` depending on layout needs).
- A closing gradient CTA band (`bg-gradient-to-br from-brand-700 via-brand-600 to-emerald-600`) driving to `/signup` — seen in `rekomendasi-alat/page.tsx:86-100` and reused inline inside the calculator's result column (`hpp-calculator.tsx:148-161`).
- Shared footer block (logo + "© {year} KasirKu. Semua hak dilindungi.").
